$comment: QA-008 identity gate policy, enforced by scripts/ci/check_identity_strings.py.
environment[] rules are matched by SHAPE, never by value, so this file never contains
a home path, an address or a hostname. identity[] rules carry the maintainer name as a
literal, which leaks nothing: it is already the copyright holder in LICENSE. The point
of that rule is not to hide the name but to keep it in the files where attribution
belongs, instead of scattered through source comments and runbooks.

environment.message: local home directory path; use a path relative to the repo root, or ~/
personal email address; point at the GitHub profile instead (see SECURITY.md)
LAN hostname; use a placeholder or an env var
private network address; use a placeholder or an env var

identity.message: maintainer name outside a designated attribution file
